messages:
noah: Heads-up: we're publishing the SDK v1 deprecation timeline and a compatibility shim in the docs today. Quick thread for rollout + responsibilities.

trina-docs: important: will the shim be code-level (library) or docs guidance only?

ben-eng: shim is a small adapter package `rw-sdk-compat` that maps v1 call signatures to v2. It lives in npm/pypi and is opt-in. We'll document install and migration examples.

trina-docs: good. please add examples showing both simple sync usage and the new async patterns, plus an example migration diff.

oliver-qa: QA note: adapter will need e2e tests against our runtime matrix (cpu/gpu, batched/unbatched). I'll add a matrix job.

ms-legal: notify: deprecation notices must include 90-day window and an email template for enterprise customers. Also ensure any telemetry changes are spelled out.

noah: timeline: day 0 publish shim + docs; day 5 send targeted emails to projects using v1 (we'll derive lists from billing/usage); day 30 begin console warnings when a v1 key is used.

ci-bot: ci: docs PR created -> rw-docs#4123; tests queued.

trina-docs: doc checklist: 1) migration diff, 2) `rw-sdk-compat` install snippets for pip/npm, 3) known limitations (no automatic KV cache transfer), 4) CHANGES.md entry.

ben-eng: compatibility note: adapter covers surface-level calls (chat/generation/embeddings). It does not emulate deprecated model names; users must pick supported model aliases. We'll add an explicit table.

oliver-qa: I'll schedule regression tests and a canary run on staging with adapter enabled.

noah: if anyone spots gotchas while drafting, ping me. TL;DR: publish compat shim + docs today, 90-day deprecation window, CI checks for CHANGES.md.
